question: Within the declared neutral closed-shell CHNO competing-event task, does geometry-side physical information add useful information while events remain editable, and can in-generation use improve independently connected channels over terminal treatment and strong adaptive serial at matched actual cost?
domain: CHNO Diels-Alder reactant-endpoint development diagnostic; cross-source T1x studies are contextual evidence, not a pooled efficacy sample
task_target: reactant-only proposal of mapped bond/electron changes and TS candidate geometry
main_outcome: unique independently TS/mode/bidirectional-IRC/endpoint-connected channels per parent at a fixed vector budget

diagnostic.selection_rule: Reuse smallest mapped atom pool then record ID among admitted training rows, as frozen for job 4100; no new outcome selection
diagnostic.atom_mapping_evidence: Audited mapped SMILES/XYZ correspondence; 64 reactant automorphisms; never inferred from element order

event_vocabulary: symmetric integer bond/electron matrix decoded by frozen m0.decode_be, CHNO valence constraints; continuous state and observed endpoint event remain distinct

trained.architecture: ReactionFlowNet joint, EMA step 60000, scalar128/vector32/edge64, 6 layers, RBF32/reactantRBF16, r_cut10
trained.load_recipe: Verify bytes/hash/status; torch.load(weights_only=True); ReactionFlowNet(**meta); load ema; eval; requires_grad_(False); input-only vocabulary shim from existing worker; no target cache import

statistical_unit: paired parent; family-aware uncertainty; seeds and trajectories are repeated observations
failure_denominator: all attempted proposals, including invalid, out-of-catalogue, unresolved, timeouts and budget stops

state_selection.policy: No substitute tensor. If reconstruction is needed, only the pinned packet/model/noise, event_lead2, 50 steps, save steps 10/25/40 before response measurement; not archived-state equivalence or new production search.
state_selection.perturbation: fixed centered deterministic direction from sampling seed; diagnostic not a physical force
state_selection.dtype: float64 CPU for derivative stability; distinct from historical float32 GPU

gates.S1: analytic and retained-row audit ready; frozen reconstruction only after input/hash verification
gates.S2: fake/cached identity fixes ready; trained bridge requires decoded atom/BE map proof
gates.S3: fake failures and separate read-only projection ready
gates.S4: existing evidence audit; no new fitted probes
gates.S5: closed until S0-S3 hard qualification and exact-endpoint S4 signal or prespecified discriminating plan
gates.S6: writing/analysis only unless S5 mechanism and independent data qualified

stopping: missing raw artifact: partial evidence, no physical rerun
